description:
<script :type={Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedHook}> in ~F must continue to register the JS hook with Phoenix at compile time and emit a regular <script> vnode in the tree at runtime.

Phoenix's MacroComponent pipeline runs at compile time; this ticket is mostly about ensuring the post-MacroComponent AST flows through the new vnode-emitting subengine without regressions.

## Files
- lib/filament/tag_engine.ex (handle_macro_component path)
- lib/filament/vnode_engine.ex

## Acceptance
- test/filament/colocated_hook_test.exs passes.
- The hook's runtime <script> tag appears in the rendered HTML.
title: Phase 1.4.6: Colocated hooks emit correctly under vnode IR
